title: docs(auth): the "Reset Password with Token" example sends `password`, but the reset door requires `newPassword` and answers 400
body:
security#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

Filed by the seat from an os-dev run's out-of-scope finding (class a, reproducible). This is a documentation defect, not a security item.

## What
`content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, section "Reset Password with Token", shows the body `{ token, password }` for `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password`. The door's body schema (better-auth `resetPassword`) requires `newPassword`. Sent as documented, the request answers:

```
400 {"message":"[body.newPassword] Invalid input: expected string, received undefined","code":"VALIDATION_ERROR"}
```

The dev measured this through `AuthManager.handleRequest` at `35af63a44c` (branch `claude/sec-hardening-c`). The door's behaviour is the same on `main`.

## Fix
Change the example's field to `newPassword`, and check the other reset/verification examples on the same page against their doors' body schemas.

Dedupe words: reset-password newPassword docs example; authentication.mdx reset body.
